column1: # M3HashMap get/put microbench, base (#2676 head 0b97282f6d1d) vs head (this leaf), JDK 21, real-pom classes: bench/bench.sh, FORKS=5 WARMUP=20 ROUNDS=60, 16384 prebuilt keys, 32 passes per round; base and head rounds alternate in one JVM (two class loaders, order flipped every round). A/A = the base classes on both sides: the machine's noise band. Values: median over forks of each side's median ns/op, median paired head/base ratio, widest 10th-90th percentile ratio band of any fork. Machine: Windows desktop under ~85 % background load at the start of the session.
